$comment: The pinned justfig-icons release (note 01), from BooneAndrewsLab/justfig-icons: `npm run icons` downloads it, or copies ../justfig-icons/dist when that is built at the same version. sha256 is of the tarball its release workflow attached (the .sha256 asset); a local `npm run pack` can differ, as gzip output depends on Node's zlib.
